race.comment: MISTY VEIL (9) easily won a maiden here at this trip three back and has been competitive since, the latest offering a close fourth over 1000m at Kembla after leading. On a seven-day back-up and comes back to her pet trip so a return to the winner's list is on the cards. ONE DESTINY (1) is back after a five-month spell. Won a similar race at this track when fresh from a spell last prep. Has a tough gate to contend with but should open this prep with another positive performance. CLOSE TO MIDNIGHT (4) led and gave plenty when pressured but eventually found one better over this course and distance three weeks ago. Fitter for two runs back from a spell and should give them something to catch. EPIC (5) started at $1.50 and scrambled to a maiden victory first-up at this track and trip recently. The time that day was comparable to a BM64 on the same card. Should run well again. Veteran BIG DAY OUT (6) can never be ruled out in a race like this.
